result.stderr:
parsley-luthor v4.1.1.0

Luthor lexer generator in a Parsley friendly package

Usage: parsley-luthor [<lexer-file>] [--output <code-file>] [--unicode]
        [--namespace <namespace>] [--class <class>] [--public]

    <lexer-file>                 The path to the lexer input file. Defaults to
                                 <stdin>.
    -o, --output <code-file>     The path to the ouput code file. Defaults to
                                 <stdout>.
    -u, --unicode                Use Unicode character classes.
    -n, --namespace <namespace>  Use the given namespace. Defaults to no
                                 namespace.
    -c, --class <class>          Use the given class name. Defaults to the
                                 input filename if available, or Lexer.
    -p, --public                 Make the class public
